summary: The Mission Bay Branch Library, a single-story San Francisco Public Library branch at 960 4th St that opened on July 8, 2006 (SFPL); the Assessor roll lists a 2005 year built.

milestones.text: Opened: San Francisco Public Library's Mission Bay Library history page states the branch opened its doors on this date.

open_questions: Pier & Point's own field photos are shown on this record. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm on 2026-09-27; fuller details shown in this record's map notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

Phil'z Coffee at 201 Berry St: DataSF Registered Business Locations gives a registration start of 2007-04-01, which is not an opening date, and no source found dates the opening; the tenant's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations) lists the Berry St store as of 2026-09-29.

The Assessor parcel this record is joined to (8708110) is listed at 201 Berry St, with a 2005 year built, while the library is at 960 4th St. DBI's permit records for 960 4th St show only house-number and street-space permits, so no construction-permit completion date is available. The date shown is the library's own stated opening.
